name: Märtopia
source:
This SLG is the first game by side-B. Akito lives with his imouto Yui, who has shut her heart to others following an accident last winter that killed their parents and put him in a coma for more than a week. He decided to use her favourite picture book to bring back a smile to her face. However, even after six long months, he was unable to get her to open up. He fell into despair seeing her as a lifeless doll and was consumed by a darkness. When he woke up, he was in a strange world Märtopia: a world where fairy tale characters reside. He was helped by a ‘bookkeeper’ Alice, and he confronted many crises while he searched for a way back to his world.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这场SLG是Side-B的第一款游戏。明人与他的妹妹结衣住在一起，去年冬天发生的一场事故导致他们的父母丧生，并导致他昏迷了一个多星期，而结衣则对他人关闭了自己的心扉。他决定用她最喜欢的图画书来让她脸上恢复笑容。然而，即使经过了漫长的六个月，他仍无法让她敞开心扉。他看到她就像一个没有生命的玩偶，陷入绝望，并被黑暗吞噬。当他醒来时，他身处一个陌生的世界Märtopia：一个童话人物居住的世界。他得到了“簿记员”爱丽丝的帮助，在寻找重返自己世界的道路时遇到了重重危机。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/07/05/july-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
